title: Advanced Machine Learning Techniques for Social Support Detection on Social Media
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the ability of various Large Language Models and transformer-based models to detect and accurately categorize online social support directed specifically toward 'Religion' as a distinct group category within social media comments.
findings: The models struggled significantly with the 'Religion' category compared to other groups. The best-performing classification model only correctly identified 47.37% of 'Religion' instances, frequently misclassifying them as 'Nation'. The study also noted that users on YouTube tended to express significant support for different nations and communities over religious considerations.
